about:
ScienceofSpeed operates from Chandler, Arizona, positioning itself as a specialist in performance parts and builds for the Honda/Acura NSX and S2000 platforms. The company runs an e-commerce storefront and publishes technical blog content covering product installations, event announcements, and a customer rewards program.

The business focuses on the niche aftermarket for two specific Honda performance models. Its catalog and project coverage center on forced-induction systems — such as the RR-MAX turbocharged setup with a V-mount intercooler configuration — along with supporting hardware and climate-control components for the NSX. The operation appears to combine parts retail with custom build documentation, though the input does not specify facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

Primary customers are owners and shops working on first- and second-generation NSXs and the AP1/AP2 S2000. The company’s blog references community events like an annual New Years meet, indicating engagement with the enthusiast community alongside direct parts sales.

No explicit founding year, ownership structure, or mission statement is provided in the available sources.
